scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
You... You got younger!!! But you are definitely YOU!
I couldn't think you were able to meet my condition...
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
你...你变年轻了！！！但确实是你本人！
我没想到你能满足我的条件...

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
Now go forth and get younger!
If you solve my riddle, then I'll give you a magical Jewel Case with a rare accessory.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
现在去吧，去变年轻吧！
如果你能解开我的谜题，我就给你一个装有稀有饰品的魔法首饰盒。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
{0} The Hero!
Now you're strong.
But... not quite strong for my riddle.
Kill {1} more Seals and return.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
英雄{0}！你现在很强了。
不过...还没强到能挑战我的谜题。
再去消灭{1}只海豹宝宝，然后回来。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
{0} The Hero!
Now you're strong.
But... not quite strong for my riddle.
Kill {1} more Poporings and come back.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
英雄{0}！你现在很强了。
不过...还没强到能挑战我的谜题。
再去消灭{1}只波波利，然后回来。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
{0} The Hero!
Now you're REALLY strong.
And if you get younger than now I'll give you my treasure.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
英雄{0}！你现在可真够强了。
要是还能变得比现在更年轻，我就把宝物给你。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
Here is your prize. It's yours for good.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
这是你的奖励。它永远属于你了。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
I've got a riddle for a strong man of 2nd Class and 99 Base Level.
*Yawn* If you meet some, please tell them about my riddle.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
我有一道谜题，想让Base等级99的二转强者来解。
*打哈欠* 遇到这样的人，就帮我转告一下吧。
